content_blocks.label: lead_paragraph
content_blocks.text: The United States economy has experienced a slowdown due to ongoing supply chain disruptions, according to latest economic reports.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_1
content_blocks.text: Manufacturing output has declined for two consecutive months, with many companies reporting shortages of raw materials and components.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_2
content_blocks.text: Experts warn that these disruptions could extend beyond the manufacturing sector, affecting retail and services industries as well.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_3
content_blocks.text: The White House announced new measures aimed at improving supply chain resilience, including increased investment in domestic manufacturing and infrastructure.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_4
content_blocks.text: However, some economists remain skeptical, citing the complexity of global trade networks as a major challenge.

content_blocks.label: pull_quote
content_blocks.text: 'We need a comprehensive approach to address these issues, rather than piecemeal solutions,' said Treasury Secretary John Smith.
